title: Extension by zero and sheafification are faithful
statement: For every ringed space X and open W, the extension-by-zero then module-sheafification functor on module sheaves is faithful.

proof.text: The extension presheaf is separated: use DirectSum.ext; for every index V → W its single summand is the input sheaf on Over W, and lift a covering sieve through Sieve.overEquiv. Separation of the input sheaf proves equality of the component. If there are no indices, DirectSum.ext is vacuous.

The sheafification unit is locally injective. Apply Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_iff_injective_of_separated to the separated underlying abelian presheaf. Naturality of the module sheafification unit then reflects equality of sheafified morphisms to equality of the extension presheaf morphisms.
Evaluate the extended morphisms on DirectSum.of at the arrow defining an object of Over W. DirectSum.lmap_of and DirectSum.of_injective recover equality of the original module morphisms.

mathlib_searches.verdict: Mathlib supplies separation and local-injectivity tools; no existing theorem for this composed extension functor.

    (SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf.{u} (moduleRings X) W ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u} (𝟙 (moduleRings X).obj)).Faithful
